gemini.value: The Spring Valley quarantine notice expanded to El Cajon on June 18, 2026, newly flagging 4 loads (SR-1003, SR-1007, SR-1012, SR-1015) for a total of 4 newly flagged loads. This covers the Spring Valley generated zone of about 100.8 sq mi (official: 111.0 sq mi), which includes 338.5 acres of commercial agriculture growing avocado, citrus, stone fruit, and tomatoes. Operations currently show 10 shipments that need review, 3 that are unclear and require a human check, and 12 shipments with no flag, while citations are verified at 16 out of 17.
